Authority is defined as the pressure drop across the fully open control valve divided by the pressure difference available to the controlled branch — CIBSE Guide H (2009) section 3.3.4.1 eq. (3.5); the same definition appears as BSRIA BG 49/2015 and in ASHRAE Handbook — HVAC Systems and Equipment (2016) ch. 47.
